oracle.project: joint-Gaussian conditioning of the scalar linear-Gaussian state-space model in exact rational arithmetic

reference_review.scope: Seven length-five arrays (filtered, predicted and smoothed means and variances, and the smoothed lag-one covariance) of one scalar AR(1) state-space model with five observations, re-derived by the retained generator and compared elementwise with the product's kalman_filter and rts_smooth.
reference_review.independence_basis: The generator builds the exact joint covariance of the five states from the declared parameters in rational arithmetic and obtains every filtered, predicted and smoothed law, and the lag-one covariance, by Gaussian conditioning of the state on the observations it is allowed to see. It contains no Kalman gain and no Rauch-Tung-Striebel backward pass, imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package, and agrees with every frozen value to 2e-16. The shared object is the model definition (state transition a, process and observation variance, observation coefficient one, and the convention that the first predicted law is the declared initial law).
reference_review.historical_exposure: Original harness deleted (preserved in historical_oracle). The retained generator was written during this review from the fixture's declared inputs and the textbook definition; the product's assertion source was read to establish which arrays are compared; no product recursion source was consulted. It reproduces every frozen value, so the frozen values were not products of a faulty product run. Who first derived the earlier values is unrecorded.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: One scalar model, one five-point series; conditioning on the full joint is equivalent to, not a test of, numerical stability of long recursions. The innovation_pack_atol field is not read by the executing assertion. Product tolerance is acceptance.atol (2e-14); the generator checks at atol/100. No uncertainty or calibration.
